videos.desc: An animated young blacksmith heats iron bars in a glowing forge, hammers rings and spirals on an anvil, quenches them in water, and proudly hangs the pieces on a finished iron gate.

A couple assembling a flat-pack chair finds one screw missing; the man crawls around the living room searching until he spots the last screw near a cardboard box, holds it up in triumph, drives it into the chair leg with a screwdriver, then sits on the finished chair to prove it holds.
videos.said: Oh, there you are! Holds solid!

videos.desc: A young couple mounts a wooden wall shelf: the woman takes a red-handled screwdriver and tightens the screws in the metal bracket while the man watches nervously, then they load books onto the shelf and she proudly shows off the screwdriver as it holds firm.

A time-lapse of two men converting an empty cargo van into a home. First the van stands open and bare in a car park and one man climbs in through the back doors. Inside, the two of them press timber studs and purple insulation panels into place along the walls under a new wooden roof frame, standing on a fresh plywood floor. On the roof under a blue sky they lower two large black solar panels into position and fix them down. The finished interior is lined with pale wood and has a white-tiled shower, a kitchen with a sink, and a skylight; four men stand inside cheering and dancing.

In an empty flat with bare walls and a parquet floor, a man in a grey beanie holds up a folded printed sheet covered in line drawings and reads it while a woman in work trousers kneels and screws round wooden legs onto a white seat. The finished stool stands on the floor. The two of them then hold the sides of a low wooden shelf unit and stand it up, and finally push together and lift a tall wooden wardrobe with shelves inside, closing its doors and stepping back to look at it.

A man in a denim apron leans over a workbench and draws a birdhouse on a sketchpad with a pencil, adding a roof, a round hole and arrows. He then fits flat wooden pieces together into the same shape, and finally holds the finished wooden birdhouse up next to his drawing, smiling at the camera.

A woman in a plaid shirt, safety glasses and a tool belt presses a cordless drill against a red brick wall; dust puffs out as the bit bites in. She then taps a wall plug into the hole with a hammer, leaving a line of fixings along the brickwork. Metal brackets go up and she lifts long pine boards onto them, pressing each shelf level against the wall. She sets a stack of coloured books on the finished shelf, then stands back with her hands on her hips looking at the two mounted shelves.

Inside a small craft workshop. Two hands hold a black open-ended spanner next to a shiny chrome one, comparing them against a pale board where a whole graded row of spanners hangs in size order. A woman in navy overalls and safety glasses then stands at a workbench with a clamp and vice, using two fine tools to fit a small brass clock movement with visible toothed wheels. At the end she reaches up to a carved wooden cuckoo clock hanging on the timber wall while a colleague works behind her.

A white-bearded man in a checked shirt stands on a wooden dock over a lake with a curly-haired boy, both gripping a fishing rod as a small fish comes up on the line. The scene cuts to a workshop close-up: a large weathered hand presses a folded sheet of sandpaper along the pitched roof of a half-finished wooden birdhouse, rubbing it back and forth while a child's hand holds the box steady. The man then stands at the workbench with five children around him, gesturing over the finished birdhouse. In the last shot two old men play chess at a low table in a park while children watch and kites fly overhead.

A bearded man in a checked shirt works outdoors on a sunny lawn beside a wire fence. He raises a hammer over his head and drives it down onto the top of a short round wooden upright. He kneels and sets the upright into a freshly dug hole in the earth next to a taller square one, then stands and swings the hammer down on it again to drive it into the ground, and wipes his forehead on his sleeve.

In a wood, a man in a blue T-shirt and work gloves cuts into a standing tree trunk with a chainsaw. A life-size bear is already emerging from the pale wood, and he saws around its shoulders and body, sending a spray of sawdust out to the side while the bark below is cut away to free the bear's legs.
videos.said: He can carve a big bear out of the wood.

videos.desc: A young man in a workshop apron grins as he works an adjustable spanner on a blue circuit board at his bench, tools hanging on the pegboard behind him. Cut to him in goggles with his hair on end, holding the small board up in both hands over a heavy bench vice. Then he stands back with a screwdriver as a small mechanism is clamped in the vice, and next a larger machine with a motor and rails sits on a rolling bench in front of him, his mouth open. Finally he throws both arms up in a garage in front of a huge machine of purple pistons and interlocking metal gears.

Gardeners in straw hats and work gloves lift large flat rectangular sheets of glass into a metal frame standing over a flower bed; sheet after sheet is slotted in side by side until the frame is completely clad, and the camera flies up through the trees to show a huge glass dome in the forest.
videos.said: Close it in. See you later.

videos.desc: A metal bucket stands on the tiled floor under an open kitchen sink cabinet, catching drips from the pipework above it. A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.

In an office two workers put up screens. A woman on a stepladder holds a cordless drill against a small bracket high on the wall while a man in a blue polo steadies it from below; he then reaches up to a round detector on the ceiling. The two of them carry a large flat screen over to the wall, lift it onto the bracket and press it firmly into place, then step back and look at it. At the end a whole wall of nine screens is up and switched on.

A bearded mechanic in blue overalls lies on a creeper and slides out from under a silver car in a busy repair shop. He then works in the open engine bay with a ratchet, loosens the wheel nuts with a red impact driver, tightens them with a long torque wrench, and finally straightens up, wipes his hands on a rag and closes the bonnet with a satisfied look.

A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

In a bright loft with big steel windows, hanging bulbs and a long table with plants, three young people kneel on the wooden floor around a stainless steel espresso machine that has been taken apart. A young woman in a white shirt fits a small brass part into the machine and studies it closely, a young man in a green T-shirt examines the copper pipes inside, and a young woman with a blonde braid turns a metal cylinder in her hands. The view moves closer. Hoses, a brass tank and a roll of spanners lie in front.

In an apple orchard at golden hour, with rows of trees under white netting and hills and a lake in the distance, the mechanical arm of a pale green robot picks a red apple from a branch and drops it into a wooden crate full of apples on its back. The view pulls back: the robot on wheels stands on the gravel path and keeps reaching into the trees by itself, while a young woman with a long braid, in a cream quilted jacket and jeans, walks past sipping from a mug, with a black and white border collie. A wooden barn stands at the end of the path.

On a narrow cobbled street between white colonial houses with green wooden balconies and red geraniums, a young man in a paint-splattered white T-shirt and jeans stands on an aluminium ladder and rolls one bright blue stripe across a bare white wall, then pushes the roller up and down so the stripe grows into a long bent line, the paint dripping down. A young woman in a rust top and black trousers holds the ladder and smiles up at him. Paint tins and a tray sit on a dust sheet below.

High on a steep red-tiled roof above a sea bay, under dark storm clouds with sunlight breaking through, a young woman with curly hair tied back, in a dark work jacket and a safety harness, kneels on the tiles. She stretches out an arm with a grey slate, turns her head and shouts out loud with her mouth wide open. A rope from a hoist hangs on the right, and two men in dark work clothes stand on the bare wooden roof battens below, holding slates. Green headlands line the coast.

On a rooftop building site at dusk with lit skyscrapers all around, a young woman in a blue and maroon superhero suit with a mask, a flowing cape and tall boots holds up a huge steel beam above her head. She rises from a crouch, pushes the beam up with one arm, then with both hands, and loose bolts fall from it onto the wooden deck. A crane hook hangs nearby, and construction workers in orange hard hats walk calmly across the roof behind her, carrying bags.

In a large open boat workshop with a corrugated roof, the shiny, silvery metal hull of a new boat hangs from ropes above a rusty steel cradle and slowly turns as it is lowered. Workers in hard hats and yellow or orange high-visibility clothes hold the ropes and guide it from below. Coils of silver wire stand in the foreground, a forklift waits behind, and the sea and a quay are visible through the wide open doors.

In a huge open-pit mine at sunset with red dusty ground, a crane lowers a massive shiny metal wheel hub, made of discs, bolts and gears fitted together, on chains. A young worker in an orange high-visibility shirt, a white hard hat and safety glasses stands on a metal platform and guides the hub with his hands onto the axle of an enormous yellow truck, then steps back. A woman watches from the truck, a big tyre lies below and a spare gear part sits on a pallet.

On a seaside promenade a huge brown dust storm rolls in behind palm trees. A young man in a blue shirt, cargo shorts, work boots and a white vest presses a sheet of plywood over the window of a small pink ice-cream kiosk with one hand and hammers a nail into it. Then he turns his head and stares at the approaching storm in alarm. The kiosk's other window is already covered with two crossed planks, and stacked plywood boards and loose planks lie on the paving while people walk a dog behind.

In a cluttered metal workshop a young woman with a black bob, yellow tinted glasses, a denim shirt and a canvas apron heaves a wheelbarrow upside down above her head and tips a shower of golden brass objects onto a huge pile on the concrete floor: door knobs, taps, keys, hinges and hooks. A scruffy terrier sits on the pile. She lowers the empty wheelbarrow, sets it down and wipes her forehead. Behind, two older men sit at a bench, and shelves are lined with polished brass pots and jugs.

On an outdoor tennis court in warm evening light a young woman in a navy work jumpsuit, with sunglasses on her head and a long braid, kneels beside the bare chassis of a motorcycle and lifts out its silver engine. She sets the engine down on the court beside her and wipes her hands on a rag. All around her hundreds of parts are laid out in neat rows: bolts, springs, gears, cables, pistons and washers. Behind the net a young man and a young woman in denim overalls stand with folded arms and watch.
